note: TL is a hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway: every lever at its limit, adopted by 2030, combining best observed attributes of different buildings and places; not a proposal or a feasible pathway (potentials hierarchy: theoretical > technical > realisable). TL = P5 Combined (Moderate) with TL1 No extra space, TL2 Historical maximum household size, TL3 No vacancy, TL4 Overbuild fully absorbed, TL5 Building lifetime extension at the limit, TL6 Best-practice materials, TL7 Zero-emission construction, TL8 Lowest-carbon soils, TL9 Brownfield maximum, TL10 Minimum space per person. TL: every lever at its limit, adopted by 2030; dwellings released by zero vacancy, the household-size change and the 2026 overbuild are re-occupied gradually, meeting a constant share (~37%) of each year's need; 2026 observed.
